item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Forloren hare (Danish mock hare), a flavourful meatloaf of pork and beef wrapped in crispy bacon, baked until juicy and served with boiled potatoes and a cream-thickened brown gravy, topped with parsley. Served with tangy-sweet redcurrant jelly and a pointed cabbage salad with apple and dill in vinaigrette. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Bicol express, a Filipino dish of pork in a creamy, umami-rich coconut sauce with vegetables, served with jasmine rice and topped with crushed jalapeño pork crackling and spring onion. Served with chilli sauce, Filipino vegetable chop suey and fresh chilli. The dish is gluten free. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: bicol express, a Filipino dish of tofu in a creamy, umami-rich coconut sauce with vegetables, served with jasmine rice and topped with crushed jalapeño and spring onion. Served with chilli sauce, Filipino vegetable chop suey and fresh chilli. The dish is gluten free. (7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Nepalese takeover: chicken rogan josh, served with rice and warm naan bread. (1+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Chana rogan josh with chickpeas, served with rice and warm naan bread. (1+8+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Nepalese chicken curry, mild but packed with spice and warmth. Served with rice and mula ko achaar (Nepalese radish pickle). (11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Nepalese vegetable curry, mild but packed with spice and warmth. Served with rice and mula ko achaar (Nepalese radish pickle). (11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Oktoberfest burger: pretzel bun with beer-marinated pork neck, topped with soft onions braised in beer and thyme. Served with white wine sauerkraut, gurkensalat (German cucumber salad), old-fashioned coarse mustard and curry ketchup. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6+8+11+13) GREEN DISH: Dish Oktoberfest burger: pretzel bun with beer-marinated Beyond Meat, topped with soft onions braised in beer and thyme. Served with white wine sauerkraut, gurkensalat (German cucumber salad), old-fashioned coarse mustard and curry ketchup. Also available gluten free. (1+2+6+8+11+13)
